read_lines_from_bytes: read lines from bytes input into a Polars DataFrame with a string column
read_lines_from_file: read lines from a file path into a Polars DataFrame with custom column name
scan_lines_from_source: scan lines from a file or directory into a LazyFrame for lazy evaluation
scan_lines_with_row_index: scan lines from a source and insert a row index column with offset
read_lines_with_file_paths: read lines from multiple files and include source file paths as a column
